reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that normalizes UI styling, coordinates layouts with other plugins, and provides live visual customization settings through CSS and runtime DOM changes.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的客户端界面增强插件，用于统一界面样式、协调插件布局并提供实时视觉定制设置。
summaries.en: A client-side DeepSeek Harness UI enhancement plugin that unifies visual styling, coordinates layouts with other plugins, and provides live customization settings.

capabilities: Applies CSS overrides and runtime DOM coordination in the browser UI
Adds live UI customization settings for chat width, font size, workspace scale, font stack, and rounded cards
Reconciles visual styles and layouts with other installed plugins
Integrates through official settings and shell UI slots
